summary.content:
Today's selection covers 105 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 74 on Artificial Intelligence and 14 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Google Earth’s AI deepfake tool only lasted one day
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: ESET tracks rise in malicious AI skills and adaptable malware
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 36 articles published in the last 24 hours
